items.item_text: Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs. Occasional evenings and weekends may be required. Must be willing and able to travel.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check.

Seven (7) years of relevant experience or a Bachelor's degree in communications, marketing, journalism, public relations, health care administration, or a related field plus three (3) years of relevant experience.
Three (3) or more years of relevant professional experience managing comprehensive communications programs.
Experience working with vendors, partner organizations, researchers, professional associations and businesses.

The Altman Clinical and Translational Research Institute (ACTRI) at UC San Diego accelerates the transformation of scientific discovery into better health by connecting research, clinical care and community impact. Established in 2008 as one of the nation's leading Clinical and Translational Science Award (CTSA) hubs supported by the National Institutes of Health, ACTRI provides the expertise, infrastructure and collaborative environment that enable researchers to move promising ideas from the laboratory to patients and communities more quickly, efficiently and equitably. Through partnerships spanning UC San Diego, regional health systems and research institutions, ACTRI plays an essential role in advancing innovative therapies, improving health outcomes and expanding access to groundbreaking clinical research.

ACTRI supports nearly every stage of the clinical and translational research enterprise, providing investigators with shared scientific resources, clinical trial support, data and informatics expertise, funding opportunities and workforce development programs that help accelerate discovery. The institute helps develop and manage hundreds of clinical studies each year while fostering the next generation of researchers through mentorship, training and interdisciplinary collaboration. From advancing precision medicine and artificial intelligence to improving community health across Southern California, ACTRI is helping shape the future of medicine by turning today's scientific breakthroughs into tomorrow's standards of care.

Clinical Research Administration (CRA) at UC San Diego provides the centralized infrastructure that enables compliant, efficient, and ethically conducted clinical research involving human participants. CRA brings together the Office of Coverage Analysis Administration (OCAA), Office of Clinical Trials Administration (OCTA), and Office of IRB Administration (OIA) to support the full lifecycle of clinical research. Through guidance, education, operational support, and coordination across the research enterprise, CRA helps investigators and study teams navigate institutional and regulatory requirements and strengthens the quality and integrity of clinical research.

The incumbent collaborates with Health Sciences and University Communications colleagues to develop, implement, and share news, content, collateral and campaigns for key internal and external audiences. Working closely with ACTRI and CRA leadership, the manager develops strategic programs that strengthen the visibility and reputation of both organizations; improve awareness of research resources, clinical trial requirements, services, and educational opportunities; and communicate accomplishments, operational updates, and institutional priorities clearly and effectively. The role requires the ability to translate complex scientific, clinical, regulatory, and administrative information into accessible, actionable communications for varied audiences.

Independently oversees a comprehensive communications program for a unit or school with moderately complex communications requirements. The communications program usually includes written, visual, digital and electronic communications. Works with management to develop and execute organizational communication and market branding strategy. Designs and implements information campaigns.
Demonstrated commitment to inclusive excellence in communications practices.

Knowledge of all aspects of communications, including strategic planning for various media venues, technical aspects and requirements of various venues, and most appropriate and effective applications.
Demonstrated working skills to produce and deliver programs and conduct needs assessments.
Knowledge and understanding of technical applications to effectively direct technical staff, or personally perform technical work, including design concepts, various media, and applications.

Knowledge of the organization, its achievements, mission, vision, goals, policies, practices, infrastructure, and a strong knowledge of current affairs, and issues in higher education and / or health sciences.
Solid skills to create, develop, and implement comprehensive long and short term strategic communications plans.
Knowledge and skills to advise and consult with management to ensure delivery of the desired message to the target and / or broad general audiences.
Solid written, verbal, interpersonal communications, active listening and political acumen skills.
Knowledge of location protocols and channels for communication internally and externally.
Strong interviewing and storytelling skills. Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, compelling narratives.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects in a dynamic environment.
Strong knowledge of website content management systems and social media platforms
Ability to evaluate effectiveness of communications strategies and recommend improvements.
Ability to maintain confidentiality.
